response.sql:
WITH item_stats AS (
  SELECT oi.order_item_id,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio,
       AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_order_item
FROM item_stats;

assumptions.assumption: The averages run over every order item, including those with no invoice line items. Those items get a count of 0 and a NULL ratio, so they are excluded from the ratio average but counted in the line-item average.
A ratio is treated as missing when derived_total_cost is NULL or 0, since NULLIF turns a zero denominator into NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Average the line-item count only over order items that have at least one invoice line item, excluding order items with zero line items from the count average.
